config.design: Three domains, task/copy, both templates. First4 pairs per domain fit coefficients, last4 evaluate. context_mean uses domain/family/template and absolute position; distance_mean uses end-relative distance pooled across all discovery contexts; family_distance additionally knows task/copy. No transfer fit. Joint replacement of entire persistent components at frozen3 readers, keeping current values live. Native-bus and opposite-endpoint donor-bus conditions. Native routing reference uses live routing at each reader, including downstream effects. Fit labels are supplied metadata, not learned context recognition.
